SELECT * FROM edu_course WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL)
AND course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT c.* FROM edu_course c INNER JOIN edu_class_course cc ON c.id = cc.course_id WHERE cc.class_id = #{classId} AND (c.deleted = 0 OR c.deleted IS NULL) AND (cc.deleted = 0 OR cc.deleted IS NULL) ORDER BY cc.assign_time DESC

SELECT c.id as course_id, c.course_name, c.cover_image, u.real_name as teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_lesson l INNER JOIN edu_chapter ch ON l.chapter_id = ch.id WHERE ch.course_id = c.id AND (l.deleted = 0 OR l.deleted IS NULL) AND (ch.deleted = 0 OR ch.deleted IS NULL)) as total_lessons, COALESCE(scs.completed_lessons, 0) as completed_lessons, COALESCE(scs.completion_rate, 0) as completion_rate, esc.create_time as last_study_time FROM edu_course c INNER JOIN edu_student_course esc ON c.id = esc.course_id AND esc.student_id = #{studentId} LEFT JOIN study_course_stat scs ON c.id = scs.course_id AND scs.student_id = #{studentId} LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE (c.deleted = 0 OR c.deleted IS NULL) ORDER BY esc.create_time DESC
